content.text: Northeast India is known for its green forests and hidden natural jewels. It is the perfect place to visit for nature lovers. Here you can spot exotic wildlife and marvel at the land's natural blessings. With Kaziranga on the 6 Days Meghalaya trip, you will see the legendary double-decker route bridge as well as the Kaziranga national park. Capture the perfect Insta photo and keep good memories. Visit Kaziranga National Park's soaring grasslands in search of One-horned Rhinoceros. You can go on a safari and keep an eye out for Royal Bengal tigers, swamp deer, Asian elephants, and wild water buffaloes.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Experience the largest man-made lake in Shillong, Umiam Lake, which spans 220 square kilometres
Get amazed by Meghalaya's picturesque road ride through the lush valley
Take in the spectacular picture of the Nohkalikai waterfalls, one of India's tallest, pouring down from a height of 1100 feet
Tour the Kaziranga National Park's soaring grasslands in search of One-horned Rhinos
While on safari, keep an eye out for Royal Bengal tigers, swamp deer, Asian elephants, and wild water buffaloes

main.title: Meghalaya Excursion with Kaziranga Tour Itinerary

days.title: Day 1 : Guwahati and Shillong
items: Arrive at Guwahati Airport or Railway Station by our representative.
Begin your fantastic adventure to Shillong.
Visit Umiam Lake at Barapani and take photos along the route.
Check in to your hotel and have a restful sleep.

days.title: Day 2 : Shillong To Cherrapunji
items: Have your delightful breakfast and head to Cherrapunji.
On the way visit the beautiful Shillong Peak.
Explore the spellbinding Mawsmai Caves, Nohkalikai Falls, and Seven Sister Falls in the Garden of Caves and Elephant Falls in Cherrapunji.
Enjoy the beautiful evening at leisure.
Check in to your hotel for a peaceful sleep.

days.title: Day 3 : Dawki and Mawlynnog Village Tour
items: After your delicious breakfast travel to Dawki and witness the amazing clean and clear Dawki River, where you can enjoy boating.
Later explore Mawlynnong Village and witness its cleanliness.
Enjoy a light walk at the village amidst the beautiful greenery.
After a little trek visit the Living Root Bridge at Riwai.
Get refresh yourself with the cool water that flows beneath the bridge.
Later head to your homestay at the village.

days.title: Day 4 : Cherrapunji to Kaziranga
items: Have your breakfast and start your tour to Kaziranga.
The picturesque road drive to Kaziranga National Park will leave you speechless.
Enjoy the gorgeous evening with the surrounding greenery.
Later on, check-in at your hotel at Kaziranga.

days.title: Day 5 : Kaziranga Sightseeing
items: Early in the morning, ride an elephant through one of the national park's zones.
Many animal and bird species, including the one-horned rhino, may be found at Kaziranga National Park.
Return to your hotel for a delectable meal.
Enjoy a vehicle safari in the Kaziranga national park in the afternoon.
Return to your accommodation for a relaxing night in Kaziranga.

days.title: Day 6 : End of the Trip
items: Drop off at Guwahati Airport / Railway Station as scheduled after breakfast.
Have a wonderful travel back to your hometown.

items.text: Travellers visiting Meghalaya are required to register on Meghalaya Tourism App and generate an e-invite.
You can download the Meghalaya Tourism App from Google Play Store or App Store.
No reimbursement will be made against missed services.
Travellers are required to show their valid identity cards at the time of check-in to the hotel.
You should not consume alcohol or other intoxicants during your tour.
The vehicle allotted for the tour will be available as per the itinerary and not for general disposal.
In the Northeast, generally, vehicles like Sedan do not have carriers. You are advised to carry one bag per person. Kindly give us prior information in case you have more luggage.

Delay in arrival due to many reasons including flight reschedules shall have to inform to us at an earliest and in case of any sightseeing spot missed due to any delay including spending more time in one sightseeing spot, will not be refundable.

Kajaawa will provide accommodation as per the hotels in the list and in case the listed hotels cannot be provided for any reason like unavailability, scheduled or general maintenance, accident at the hotel, risky road conditions due to bad weather or political disturbance, similar hotels will be provided and you will be informed about the changes in advance.

In Deluxe and Premium Tour Packages, we will generally arrange Deluxe and Premium Hotels but in interior places, we will arrange Homestays, Guest Houses or Standard Hotels as Deluxe and Premium accommodations may not be available in the interiors for any reason.
In case of any unforeseen situations which is beyond our control including bad weather conditions, political disturbance etc., we may change your itinerary or dates of travel.
Travellers may have to bear additional expenses in case of natural calamity including situations like changes in the hotel, changes in tour date etc.
You have to pay 50% of the total tour cost at the time of booking.
After paying 50% you will receive an invoice of your payment and also booking confirmation details containing your detailed travel itinerary and hotel information.
25% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 30 days before the tour starts.
50% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 15-30 days before the tour starts.
100% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 0-15 days before the tour starts.
100% of the tour cost has to be paid 1 (one) week before the tour starts.
Refunds will be processed within 7 (seven) business days in the customer's bank account.
